title: 1. 论劳动力概念：身体与潜能
originalTitle: 1. On the Concept of Labour-Power: Body and Potential

children: 1. On the Concept of Labour-Power: Body and Potential

zh: 1. 论劳动力概念：身体与潜能

en: Capitalism is the first fully historical form of social organisation. Not only and not so much because it spells the ruin of every established tradition, fomenting the uninterrupted revolutionising of the processes of production and customs of life. But for a more radical reason. If we called the conditions that guarantee the history of any given event ‘meta-historical’, we could say that capitalism

, bringing it into the prosaic ambit of events and appropriating it for itself. Marx writes: ‘capital presupposes: (1) the production process in general, such as is common to all social conditions, that is, without historic character … the production process in general comes to be modified historically as soon as it becomes merely an element of capital’.
We should take ‘production in general’ to mean: that which comprises the ensemble of real or possible labours. But this invariant and pervasive aspect is nothing other than the
, a simple anthropological fact (‘as is common to all social conditions’). Capitalism lays its claim to
production-in-general, conferring on it the rank of an empirical phenomenon for the first time, because its peculiar

character (that which most separates it from the previous social systems) consists in reducing the generic production-potential to a commodity. Meta-history irrupts into ordinary history in the none-too-sublime guise of labour-power.
zh: 资本主义是第一种充分历史性的社会组织形式。这不仅、也不主要是因为它意味着一切既定传统的毁灭，煽动生产过程与生活习俗持续不断的革命化，而是出于一个更根本的理由。如果我们把使任何既定事件具有历史性的条件称作‘元历史的’，就可以说，资本主义使元历史历史化，把它带入事件的平凡领域并据为己有。马克思写道：‘资本预设：（1）一般生产过程，它为所有社会状态所共有，因而不具有历史性质……一旦一般生产过程仅仅成为资本的一个要素，它便得到历史改造。’
我们应当把‘一般生产’理解为包含现实或可能劳动总体的东西。但这个不变且无所不在的方面，无非是劳动官能，一个简单的人类学事实——‘为所有社会状态所共有’。资本主义对元历史的一般生产提出所有权要求，第一次赋予它经验现象的地位，因为资本主义特殊的历史性质——最使它区别于此前社会体系之处——就在于把一般生产潜能还原为商品。元历史以劳动力这种毫不崇高的面貌闯入普通历史。

en: The buying and selling of the capacity-to-labour is an exchange between juridically equal subjects whose personal freedom is not in question. With no little sarcasm directed against those who accuse capitalism of undermining the rule of law, Marx observes: ‘Equality and freedom are thus not only respected in exchange based on exchange values but, also, the exchange of exchange values is the productive, real basis of all
and

children: But we need to look at the content of the transaction more closely. Unlike any other commodity

en: , ‘The use value which the worker has to offer to the capitalist … is not materialized in a product, does not exist apart from him at all, thus exists not really, but only in potentiality, as his capacity.’

How does labour-power, something lacking in presence and which does ‘not really exist’, achieve the status of an inalienable use-value when exchanged for money? Potential becomes a good in itself only when it is radically separated from the correlated acts. The worker sells her labour-power because, without any means of production of her own, she cannot apply it by herself. If she were not a
citizen (if her whole person belonged, by law, to others), the proletarian would not be able to put a personal faculty like
labour-power onto the market. But if she were not
of all economic resources, she would have no reason to do so. Free and also expropriated: juridical independence goes hand-in-hand with material dependence.
Only the intersection of these two conditions makes it possible for potential to emerge in the world of appearances as the concrete stakes of an exchange, thus achieving its
or revelation.
zh: 劳动能力的买卖，是法律上平等的主体之间的交换，他们的人身自由不容置疑。马克思颇带讽刺地针对那些指责资本主义破坏法治的人指出：‘因此，以交换价值为基础的交换不仅尊重平等和自由，而且交换价值的交换本身就是一切平等和自由的生产性现实基础。’
但我们需要更仔细地观察这项交易的内容。不同于其他任何商品，‘工人必须提供给资本家的使用价值……没有物化在产品中，根本不离开工人而存在，因此并非现实地存在，只潜在地作为他的能力而存在。’

劳动力这种缺乏在场并且‘并非现实地存在’的东西，在同货币交换时如何取得不可让渡的使用价值地位？只有同相关实现彻底分离时，潜能才成为一种独立物品。工人出售自己的劳动力，因为她没有属于自己的生产资料，无法自行运用它。如果她不是自由公民——如果她整个人在法律上属于他人——无产者就无法把劳动力这样的个人官能投放市场；但如果她没有被剥夺一切经济资源，她也没有理由这样做。既自由又被剥夺：法律独立与物质依赖携手同行。
只有两个条件的交叉，才使潜能能够作为一项交换的具体标的出现在显象世界中，从而实现它的降临（parousia）或启示。
body.review: 校订疑点 S6：英文明确写 inalienable use-value；暂保留‘不可让渡’，但与同段买卖关系及后文可让渡表述冲突，尚待其他版本确认。

en: . The incarnation of meta-history within the historically determinate capitalist production relation subverts and complicates any interpretation of temporality. Let us remind ourselves of a point we stressed in the second part of this book: potential, which by itself does
not fall
time (being a persistent not-now), nonetheless does participate in the progression of chronology in virtue of its relation with the act, i.e. indirectly.

we utter a phrase or start labouring, the nexus that links these actions to their respective faculties – the capacity-to-speak and labour-power, respectively – comes to the surface; therefore, in that precise instant, and neither before nor after it, these faculties also find a place in the calendar. Conclusion: if we limit ourselves to considering the progression of time, potential is always
to the act. Yet in the epoch of capitalism, this is no longer wholly true. It is the exchange between money and labour-power that changes the situation: for this entails the insertion of potential
becoming, within the accounts, but independently of the act. The capacity-to-produce is bought and sold
the productive process has begun: ‘The alienation of labour-power and its actual appropriation by the buyer, its employment as a use-value, are separated by an interval of time.’

The moment of alienation is the moment in which the not-now as such (and not thanks to its relation with an actuality) is wedged into empirical history. The separation between the date of the exchange, which concerns the faculty of labour, and the date of the really executed labour, corroborates our initial assertion: namely, that the heterogeneity of act and potential not only gives rise to history but ultimately emerges as a specific historical fact.
zh: 释论。元历史在历史上确定的资本主义生产关系中取得肉身，这颠覆并复杂化了对时间性的任何阐释。让我们回想本书第二部分强调过的一点：潜能自身不落入时间——它是持续的非现在——却凭借同实现的关系间接参与年代推进。当我们说出一句话或开始劳动时，把这些行动同各自官能——言说能力和劳动力——联结起来的联系便浮出表面；因此，恰恰在那个瞬间，不早也不晚，这些官能也在历法中找到位置。结论是：如果只考察时间推进，潜能始终与实现同时。然而在资本主义时代，这一点不再完全成立。改变局面的，是货币与劳动力之间的交换：它使潜能独立于实现而嵌入生成、嵌入账目。生产能力在生产过程开始以前就被买卖：‘劳动力的让渡同购买者对它的现实占有、即把它作为使用价值来使用，在时间上彼此分离。’
让渡时刻，就是非现在本身——而不是凭借它同某项现实性的关系——楔入经验历史的时刻。涉及劳动官能的交换日期与实际实行劳动的日期相分离，印证了我们最初的论断：实现与潜能的异质性不仅产生历史，最终还作为一个具体历史事实显现。

en: At first blush, capital appears as an enormous deposit of
, executed some time previously and turned into exchange-value. The only thing different to it (and able to increase it) is the worker: ‘non-objectified
labour, labour which is still objectifying itself, labour as subjectivity’.
Non-objectified labour, the mere faculty of producing, is however ‘a capacity of his bodily existence; has no existence apart from that’.

Every time it tries to procure labour-power, capital comes up against a living body. This latter does not, in itself, count for anything from an economic point of view, but it is necessary in that it is the temple of what really matters: ‘labour as subjectivity’. The living body, pillaged of every one of its qualities except pure vitality itself, becomes the
of productive capacity, the tangible
of potential, the objective
of non-objectified labour. If money is the universal representation of exchange-values, then
is the extrinsic equivalent of the only use-value that ‘is not materialized in a product’.
zh: 乍看之下，资本表现为一座庞大的对象化劳动仓库：这些劳动曾在过去某时实行，并转化为交换价值。唯一不同于资本、并能使它增长的东西，是工人：‘非对象化劳动，仍在使自身对象化的劳动，作为主体性的劳动’。
然而，非对象化劳动——单纯的生产官能——是‘工人的身体存在的一种能力；离开这种身体存在，它便没有存在’。
资本每次试图取得劳动力，都会遇到一个活的身体。从经济角度看，这个身体自身并不算什么；但它又不可或缺，因为它是那种真正重要之物——‘作为主体性的劳动’——的神殿。活的身体被掠夺掉除纯粹生命力本身以外的一切性质，于是成为生产能力的基底、潜能的有形标志、非对象化劳动的客观外观。如果货币是交换价值的普遍代表，那么生命就是唯一‘没有物化在产品中’之使用价值的外在等价物。

en: The far from mythological origin of that mechanism of knowledges and powers which Michel Foucault termed
should undoubtedly be sought out within the mode of existence of labour-power. The practical importance which potential assumes

potential within the capitalist mode of production; its inseparability from immediate ‘bodily existence’ – this and only this is the foundation of the biopolitical perspective. Foucault thumbs his nose at those libertarian theorists (Wilhelm Reich, for example) according to whom spasmodic attention to life is the fruit of a repressive intent: to discipline bodies in order to increase labour productivity. Foucault

is very much in the right, but is here up against an easy opposition. The governance of life runs from the containment of impulses to the most boundless licence, from pedantic forbidding to the heights of tolerance, from ghettoes for the poor to Keynesian high salaries, from the maximum security prison to the welfare state. That said, the crucial question remains:
is life as such taken care of, governed? The answer is straightforward: because it serves as the

for a faculty, labour-power, which has the autonomous significance of a use-value. What is at issue here is not the productivity of actual labour, but the exchangeability of the potential to labour itself. Simply on account of being bought and sold, this potential also calls into question the breeding-ground from which it is inseparable: the living body; moreover, it puts the body on display wholly as an object of knowledge and governance (of countless different governing strategies). It goes without saying that life, considered as a generic substratum of potential, is an amorphous life, reduced to a few essential,
traits. Biopolitics is a particular derivative aspect of the inscription of
within the field of empirical phenomena; an inscription, as we already know, that distinguishes capitalism
zh: 米歇尔·福柯称作生命政治的知识与权力机制

，其绝非神话的起源无疑应当在劳动力的存在方式中寻找。在资本主义生产方式中，潜能作为潜能所取得的实践重要性，以及它同直接的‘身体存在’不可分离——这、也只有这，才是生命政治视角的基础。福柯嘲讽那些自由解放论者（libertarian theorists）——例如威廉·赖希——因为在他们看来，对生命的痉挛式关注源自压抑意图：规训身体以提高劳动生产率。福柯完全正确，不过他在这里面对的是一个容易击败的对手。对生命的治理，从遏制冲动到最无拘束的放任，从琐细禁令到高度宽容，从穷人隔离区到凯恩斯主义高工资，从最高安全等级监狱到福利国家，无所不包。尽管如此，关键问题仍然存在：为什么生命本身受到照料和治理？答案很直接：因为生命充当一种官能——劳动力——的基底，而这种官能拥有使用价值的自主意义。这里关涉的不是现实劳动的生产率，而是劳动潜能本身的可交换性。仅仅因为被买卖，这种潜能也把同它不可分割的滋生地——活的身体——置于问题之中；而且，它把整个身体展示成知识和治理——无数不同治理策略——的对象。不言而喻，被视作潜能一般基底的生命，是无定形的生命，被还原成少数本质的元历史特征。生命政治是元历史铭写进经验现象领域所派生的一个特殊方面；我们已经知道，正是这种铭写构成资本主义的历史特征。

en: The inseparability of the potential to produce from the living body also helps explain the inglorious mystery of the

(the true apex of biopolitics, indeed). To those who claim that wages are a question for trade unionists and not philosophers, we can only reply that on the basis of such a criterion Heidegger would have to be considered a chemicals expert simply because he often concerned himself with technology. But let us get to the point. In offering the wage, the capitalist wants to
buy labour-power, or ‘labour as subjectivity’, and not the living body itself. A worker’s life – unlike that of the slave – has no price-tag: ‘As a slave, the worker has
, a value; as a free wage-worker he has
; it is rather his power of disposing of his labour, effected by exchange with him, which has value.’

Potential and life are made of the same substance, but are not identical: to put a price on the former goes hand-in-hand with devaluing the latter. But how is the exchange-value of potential determined? On the basis of what parameters is the wage determined?
zh: 生产潜能同活的身体不可分离，也有助于解释工资那并不光彩的奥秘——事实上，工资正是生命政治的顶点。对于那些声称工资是工会人士而非哲学家的问题的人，我们只能回答：按照这种标准，海德格尔仅仅因为经常关心技术，就必须被当作化学专家。还是直入要点。资本家提供工资，想购买的是劳动力或‘作为主体性的劳动’，而不是活的身体本身。不同于奴隶的生命，工人的生命没有标价：‘作为奴隶，工人具有交换价值，具有价值；作为自由雇佣工人，他没有价值；有价值的反而是他支配自己劳动的力量，而这种力量通过同他的交换得到实现。’
潜能与生命具有相同的实质，却并不相同：给前者定价，同贬低后者携手并行。但潜能的交换价值如何确定？工资依据什么参数确定？

en: There is a difficulty here. Objectified labour, which the capitalist possesses in the form of money,

commensurable with non-objectified labour, with the faculty to labour as such. This, for the very same reasons that in general forbid any equivalence being drawn between a series of completed acts and a potential (not-now): while acts play out in time and can be broken down into parts, potential cannot be, and is devoid of chronological location. Thus in order to establish the price of labour-power, we need a

that allows a comparison and exchange of the two heterogeneous poles (money and ‘labour as subjectivity’), a term which has points of contact with each of them. This middle term is, in fact, amorphous and unqualified
, ‘immediate bodily existence’. Like objectified labour, the living body is something

; or better, it is a product whose costs (means of subsistence, costs of education and training, etc.) amount to determinate quantities of objectified labour. On the other hand, the living body is inseparable from potential, a fact that constitutes its substratum. The price of

labour-power, the wage, conforms to this middle term. In order to obtain the only good that will satisfy his appetite – potential – the capitalist offers remuneration corresponding to the maintenance of that which does not, conversely, have value: life.
Even though it is exempt from exchange (or for this very reason), the substratum
provides the
for exchange itself.
zh: 这里存在一个困难。资本家以货币形式占有的对象化劳动，同非对象化劳动、同劳动官能本身不可通约；理由也正是一般来说禁止我们在一系列已完成实现与一种潜能——非现在——之间建立任何等价关系的理由：实现发生于时间，可以分割成部分；潜能却不能，而且没有年代位置。因此，为确定劳动力价格，我们需要一个中项，使异质的两极——货币与‘作为主体性的劳动’——能够比较和交换；这个中项必须同两极都有接触点。它事实上就是无定形且无规定的生命，即‘直接的身体存在’。像对象化劳动一样，活的身体是某种现实之物；更准确地说，它是一种产品，其成本——生活资料、教育培训费用等等——等于确定数量的对象化劳动。另一方面，活的身体同潜能不可分离，生命这一事实构成潜能的基底。劳动力价格即工资，依照这个中项而确定。为了得到唯一能够满足其欲望的物品——潜能——资本家支付的报酬，对应于维持那种反而没有价值之物——生命——的费用。
作为基底的生命虽然被排除在交换之外——或者正因为如此——却为交换本身提供计量单位。

en: Let us repeat. The buying and selling of labour-power attests to the fact that meta-history has established itself within the very heart of contemporary history. The division between potential and act, the hidden cornerstone of historical praxis, assumes unprecedented prominence when potential appears in and by itself – separated from the act – as the eminent content of an economic transaction. That is, when the not-now takes on the modest aspect of something that is at our fingertips, once its use-value and exchange-value are recognised. Before we go any further, it is worth making another clarification. We need to understand clearly – to the letter – Marx’s definition of labour-power: ‘the sum of all the physical and intellectual aptitudes existent in corporeality’.

, note. In speaking of labour-power, we implicitly refer to any sort of faculty: linguistic competence, memory, the capacity-to-think and so on. ‘Labour-power’ does not indicate a circumscribed potential, but is rather the name
to the various different types of

potential; or better, the name suitable for them in so far as they are relevant to production and appear as ‘non-objectified labour’. To the exact extent that the various faculties are part of labour-power, they share in its destiny: they impose themselves with the peremptoriness of an empirical fact. An example: the capacity-to-speak, as such – as distinct from any speech act – appears as a concrete object of experience in so far as it is involved in the exchange between money and the ‘sum of all the worker’s aptitudes’. And the same goes for the capacity-to-remember or the capacity-to-think. In summary: the concept of labour-power points to both the eventual orientation of the faculties towards production, and their worldly epiphany.
zh: 让我们再说一遍。劳动力的买卖证明，元历史已经在当代历史的核心地带安顿下来。潜能与实现之间的分离——历史实践隐蔽的基石——在潜能自身、独立于实现而作为经济交易的首要内容出现时，取得前所未有的显著地位。也就是说，一旦非现在的使用价值与交换价值得到承认，它便呈现为近在手边之物那朴素的面貌。在继续以前，还值得作另一项澄清。我们必须严格按字面理解马克思对劳动力的定义：‘存在于身体性中的全部体力和智力资质之总和。’请注意，是全部。谈论劳动力时，我们隐含地指涉任何种类的官能：语言能力、记忆、思考能力等等。‘劳动力’并不表示一种范围受限的潜能，而是各种不同类型潜能的共同名称；更准确地说，是当它们同生产相关并表现为‘非对象化劳动’时适用于它们的名称。各种官能只要构成劳动力的一部分，就会分享劳动力的命运：它们以经验事实那种不容置疑的力量强加自身。举例说，言说能力本身——有别于任何言说行动——之所以作为具体经验对象出现，是因为它参与货币与‘工人全部资质之总和’之间的交换。记忆能力或思考能力同样如此。概括而言：劳动力概念既指向诸官能可能朝向生产的取向，也指向它们在世俗世界中的显现。

en: It is now worth asking ourselves in what forms the practical revelation of potential takes place also within the production process properly speaking (that which follows the buying and selling of the capacity to produce). I would here like to sketch out – if only in draft form – the following thesis: at the culmination of capitalist
development,
labour consists of the exhibition (more than the application) of the

to labour: the real execution imitates the faculty’s mode of existence, rather than being separated from it; the structural characteristics of labour-power (latency, inseparability from the worker’s living body, etc.) infect the specific operations through which it is explicated. Let us pass over the middle stages of labouring acts’
(though it would be interesting to re-examine the very notion of ‘abstract labour’ from such a perspective). The present-day situation will suffice, and serves to illustrate this thesis.
zh: 现在值得追问：在严格意义上的生产过程——即生产能力买卖之后的过程——内部，潜能的实践启示还采取哪些形式？这里我想以草图形式勾勒如下论题：在资本主义发展的顶点，现实劳动与其说是对劳动潜能的运用，不如说是对它的展示；实际实行并未同官能分离，反而模仿官能的存在方式；劳动力的结构特征——潜伏性、同工人活的身体不可分离等等——感染了它借以得到展开的具体操作。让我们略过劳动行动模仿潜能（imitatio potentiae）的中间阶段——尽管从这个视角重新考察‘抽象劳动’概念本身会很有意思。说明这一论题，当前处境就已足够。

en: Delineating a historical tendency which today seems to have been realised down to the last detail, Marx wrote that: ‘Labour no longer appears so much to be included within the production process; rather, the human being comes to relate more as watchman and regulator to the production process itself … He steps to the side of the production process instead of being its chief actor.’

He who limits himself to standing at the side of the production cycle, adopting the role of watchman and regulator, alternates single performances with a state of vigilant inaction. During the working day, he remains a mere potential across long intervals: unapplied, yet available all the same. The labour performed preserves – precisely as it is being performed – the characteristics of ‘non-objectified labour’. That is, it maintains the physiognomy of labour-power. The worker’s exertion is to be found in the oscillation – promptly and with the right timing – from the not-now of the faculty to the ‘now’ of the execution. This is an activity which each time expresses
and articulates anew the

between potential and act. There is more. You will remember that labour-power is a use-value that is ‘not materialised in a product’, and does not exist outside of the ‘living subject’ in which it inheres. Yet this prerogative of potential is reversed in the production process, and comes to characterise also the modalities and results of the labour that is being performed. As a watchman and regulator, the worker does not fashion an object external to himself, but rather carries out
actions that are an end in themselves.

In at least one aspect, production based on language resembles the virtuoso interpretations performed by a pianist or an actor: the lack of an enduring final product implies that the use-value of the labour provided is never separable from the person who executed it.
Just like the use-value of labour-power, indeed.
zh: 马克思在勾勒一种今天看来已经实现到每一处细节的历史趋势时写道：‘劳动不再主要表现为被纳入生产过程；相反，人同生产过程本身发生关系，更多是作为监看者和调节者……他站到生产过程旁边，而不再是其主要行动者。’

只站在生产循环旁边、扮演监看者和调节者的人，会在单次操作与警觉的不行动状态之间交替。在工作日的很长间隔中，他仍只是潜能：未被运用，却始终可以调用。正在实行的劳动，恰恰在实行时仍保存‘非对象化劳动’的特征，也就是保持劳动力的面貌。工人的努力，在于及时而准确地在官能的非现在与实行的‘现在’之间切换。这是一种每次都重新表达并分节潜能与实现之差异的活动。还不止如此。读者会记得，劳动力是一种‘没有物化在产品中’的使用价值，不存在于它所寓居的‘活的主体’之外。然而，潜能的这一特权在生产过程中发生反转，也开始刻画正在实行的劳动之方式与结果。作为监看者和调节者，工人并不塑造一个外在于自己的对象，而是完成以自身为目的的语言行动。
至少在一个方面，以语言为基础的生产类似钢琴家或演员所作的技艺性表演：缺少持久的最终产品，意味着所提供劳动的使用价值永远不能同实行它的人分离。
事实上，这恰好同劳动力的使用价值一样。

en: Capitalism is the first fully historical form of social organisation. But it is also the only one that has been able
to pass itself off, from the outset and ever anew, as the

. This is not only a case of its apologists being immoderately zealous. History appears to have stopped on account of the same event that has in other senses unleashed it in unprecedented measure: the explicit, almost tangible, or even trivial, manifestation of the presuppositions on which the historicity of experience depends. When these presuppositions stick out right in front of us, with the same obviousness as a civil war or financial crisis, we can believe well enough that they have exhausted their function: is it not, after all, true that only the dried-up root comes to the surface? The Revelation is exchanged for an Epilogue. The conditions of possibility of history are taken for given facts; but, and this is the point, they are taken for
given facts, recurrent and
ones. Capitalism, for which the conditions of possibility of history become a productive resource, thus seems to represent only certain

elements of human praxis. The society that appeals to ‘production in general’ (and literally profits from the fundamental difference between potential and act) keenly boasts its post-historical pedigree.
zh: 资本主义是第一种充分历史性的社会组织形式。但它也是唯一一种从一开始、并不断重新把自己冒充为历史终结的形式。这不只是因为资本主义辩护士热情过度。历史之所以显得已经停止，源自同一个在其他意义上以空前程度释放历史的事件：经验之历史性所依赖的诸前提明确、几乎有形甚至平庸地显现。当这些前提像内战或金融危机一样不言自明地突出在我们面前时，我们很容易相信它们已经穷尽自身功能：毕竟，难道不是只有枯萎的根才会露出地面吗？启示被误认作尾声。历史的可能性条件被当作既定事实；但关键在于，它们被当作永久的既定事实、反复出现且非历史的事实。资本主义把历史之可能性条件变成生产资源，因而显得只是体现了人类实践中某些不变要素。诉诸‘一般生产’——并且从潜能与实现的根本差异中获取字面意义上的利润——的社会，急切地夸耀自己的后历史血统。

en: Marx reproaches political economy for a far from innocent misinterpretation: that of representing the capitalist production relation, which is unmistakeably a ‘historic result’, as history’s ‘point of departure’.

And right he is. But we must add: this malicious misreading is fed by the fact that the ‘historic result’ in question has the singular prerogative of really mobilising history-in-general’s ‘point of departure’ – its fundamental presuppositions – in its own favour. When capitalism appropriates an anthropological requisite like the potential to produce, the accent can fall

either on the contextualised ways in which the appropriation takes place, or on the indeterminate character of this requisite, pertaining to any epoch or society. The second emphasis points to the ‘bourgeois narrow-mindedness, which regards the capitalist forms of production as absolute forms – hence as eternal, natural forms of production’.

It is the concept of labour-power that explains the spread of a state of mind (little matter whether it be melancholic or euphoric) inspired by the ‘end of History’. Or better: it forces us to recognise that this end is, yes, an appearance, but a necessary appearance encapsulated within the dominant mode of production, and sometimes corroborated by the very processes that might also serve to deny it.
zh: 马克思责备政治经济学作出一种绝非无辜的误释：把无可置疑是‘历史结果’的资本主义生产关系，表述成历史的‘出发点’。
他完全正确。但我们必须补充：这种恶意误读之所以得到滋养，是因为所论‘历史结果’拥有一种独特特权——它确实为了自身利益而动员一般历史的‘出发点’，即历史的根本前提。当资本主义占有生产潜能这样的人类学条件时，重音既可以落在这种占有发生的具体方式上，也可以落在该条件属于任何时代或社会的不确定性质上。第二种强调指向‘资产阶级的狭隘性；它把资本主义生产形式看作绝对的、因而永恒且自然的生产形式’。
正是劳动力概念解释了受‘历史终结’启发的心态——无论忧郁还是欢欣——为何广泛传播。更准确地说，它迫使我们承认，这个终结固然是显象，却是包含在主导生产方式内部的一种必然显象，而且有时恰恰得到那些也可能用来否定它的过程的印证。

en: The following paragraphs are limited to articulating what we have just said with regard to labour-power’s mode of existence. They are dedicated to two crucial themes of historical materialism: religious ritual and pre-history.
zh: 以下各段只把我们刚才关于劳动力存在方式所说的内容进一步展开。它们分别讨论历史唯物主义的两个关键主题：宗教仪式与前历史。

The simplest abstraction, then, which modern economics places at the head of its discussions, and which expresses an immeasurably ancient relation valid in all forms of society, nevertheless achieves practical truth as an abstraction only as a category of the most modern society.’

zh: ‘我们正在离开的这个领域〔流通领域〕——劳动力买卖在其边界内进行——事实上是真正的天赋人权乐园。在那里，占统治地位的只有自由、平等、所有权和边沁。自由，因为一种商品——比如劳动力——的买者与卖者都只受自己的自由意志约束；他们作为自由行动者订立契约，他们达成的协议只是以法律形式表达共同意志。平等，因为每一方都仅仅作为商品所有者同另一方发生关系，以等价物交换等价物。所有权，因为每一方只支配属于自己的东西。边沁，因为每一方都只考虑自己。把他们联结起来并使他们彼此发生关系的唯一力量，是各自的利己心、收益和私人利益。’（马克思，《资本论》第一卷，第6章）马克思作品中这类段落比比皆是。其目的，是把混淆资本主义与建立在法律依赖之上的旧制度的倾向扼杀在萌芽中，并说明劳动力买卖非但不违反法国大革命原则，反而以最严谨的方式贯彻它们。这里无疑存在图式化过度。扬·穆里耶—布唐的《被束缚的雇佣劳动》（Le salariat bridé，巴黎：法国大学出版社，1998年）极其详细地重构了资本主义重新建立对劳动力之直接支配形式的倾向。人身臣服和法律从属从未完全消失在视域之外。
en: ‘This sphere that we are deserting [the sphere of circulation], within whose boundaries the sale and purchase of labour-power goes on, is in fact a very Eden of the innate rights of man. There alone rule Freedom, Equality, Property and Bentham. Freedom, because both buyer and seller of a commodity, say of labour-power, are constrained only by their own free will. They contract as free agents, and the agreement they come to, is but the form in which they give legal expression to their common will. Equality, because each enters into relation with the other, as with a simple owner of commodities, and they exchange equivalent for equivalent. Property, because each disposes only of what is his own. And Bentham, because each looks only to himself. The only force that brings them together and puts them in relation with each other, is the selfishness, the gain and the private interests of each’ (Marx,
, vol. I, Chapter 6). Passages of the kind abound in Marx. Their purpose is to crush in the egg the tendency to confuse capitalism for the

based on juridical dependence, and to demonstrate how the buying and selling of labour-power, far from violating the principles of the French Revolution, applies them with the greatest scruple. There is doubtless an excess of schematism here. Yann Moulier-Boutang’s

(Paris: PUF 1998) reconstructs in great detail capitalism’s tendency to re-establish direct forms of dominion over labour-power. Personal subjection and juridical subalternity have never completely disappeared over the horizon.

zh: ‘一般说来，〔工人的〕商品之交换价值，不能由买者使用它的方式来规定，而只能由其中包含的对象化劳动量规定；因此在这里，只能由再生产工人自身所需要的劳动量规定。因为他所提供的使用价值，只作为他的身体存在的一种本领、一种能力〔Vermögen〕而存在；离开这种身体存在，它便没有存在。’（马克思，《政治经济学批判大纲》，第5章）
en: ‘In general terms, the exchange value of [the worker’s] commodity cannot be determined by the manner in which its buyer uses it, but only by the amount of objectified labour contained in it; hence, here, by the amount of labour required to reproduce the worker himself. For the use value which he offers exists only as an ability, a capacity [
] of his bodily existence; has no existence apart from that’ (Marx,

zh: 不同官能依照一组可变的等级关系彼此关联。每当我们改变视角——改变引导研究的问题——某一种特定 dynamis 形态就会升到首位，压倒其余形态。当问题是阐明潜能概念本身，指出把它同‘潜在实现’概念分隔开的裂隙时，语言官能居于中心（参见上文第二部分第4节）。随后，当我们追问借助什么手段认识 dynamis 时，轮到记忆取得首要角色，因为这种官能提供通向其他一切官能的路径（参见上文第二部分第8节）。现在，问题转为潜能的历史—经验显现。在最后这个视角中，占据领导地位的是劳动力。其他官能如果也取得直接的现象意义——作为其自身，而不是凭借其运用——那是因为它们共同构成生产能力。
